title: Boltwood Capital Management Cuts Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Sep 23rd, 2018 // No Comments
Boltwood Capital Management decreased its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 11.1% during the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 20,729 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,586 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 2.5% of Boltwood Capital Management’s holdings, making the stock its 6th largest position. Boltwood Capital Management’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,837,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other large investors also recently made changes to their positions in the stock. Hutner Capital Management Inc. purchased a new position in shares of Apple during the second quarter valued at approximately $213,000. First American Trust FSB boosted its position in Apple by 21.5% in the second quarter. First American Trust FSB now owns 67,601 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,514,000 after purchasing an additional 11,951 shares during the last quarter. Clinton Group Inc. purchased a new position in Apple in the second quarter worth $2,066,000. Stonebridge Capital Management Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 464.1% in the second quarter. Stonebridge Capital Management Inc. now owns 54,246 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $10,058,000 after purchasing an additional 44,630 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Versant Capital Management Inc boosted its position in Apple by 13.1% in the second quarter. Versant Capital Management Inc now owns 9,970 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,845,000 after purchasing an additional 1,156 shares during the last quarter. 58.54% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $217.66 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $149.16 and a 52-week high of $229.67. The firm has a market cap of $1,081.48 billion, a P/E ratio of 23.63, a P/E/G ratio of 1.94 and a beta of 1.33.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $1.67 EPS. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current year.
In related news, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Friday, August 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total transaction of $3,039,817.20. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,683,563.96. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders have sold 378,400 shares of company stock worth $81,052,754. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
Several research analysts have weighed in on the company. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Wednesday. Atlantic Securities reissued a “neutral” rating and issued a $205.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. Nomura set a $210.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Thursday, September 13th. BMO Capital Markets boosted their price objective on Apple from $184.00 to $199.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Finally, UBS Group set a $250.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, September 17th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating and twenty-nine have given a buy rating to the company. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $217.53.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
